newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian Air halts flights to Tirana amid unrest.
newsitem.headline: Austrian Air halts flights to Tirana amid unrest.

text.p: Austria's flagship carrier Austrian Airlines said on Thursday it had cancelled flights to Tirana until further notice due to unrest in the Albanian capital.
"We have cancelled the one flight we had for today to Tirana because of the current unrest. Flights will not be resumed until further notice," a spokeswoman at the airline told Reuters.

Shooting was clearly heard in Tirana overnight as looters who had seized weapons from a military academy fired in celebration. Albania has plunged into chaos following two months of unrest sparked by the collapse of pyramid investment schemes left thousands penniless.
On Wednesday, a Greek airliner aborted a landing at Tirana because the airport was closed. A foreign ministry spokesman in Athens said shooting was heard.
